'''Barin Trevina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] and accomplished thief. He was born on [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]] but soon migrated to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in search of opportunities. He was known for his ability to get in and out of tight spaces. He bragged he could enter and leave any building in Mos Eisley and often would wager on the success of his "expeditions."<ref name="Scum and Villainy/>

Trevina was short and thin, and wore his hair short. He was a favored employee of [[Prello Anjiliac|Prello the Hutt]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy/>
